scenarios.description: Measure delivery of spoken instructions, timed interaction context and contact-sheet pixels through the registered Apparent Hermes tool.
scenarios.userEntryPoint: Invoke apparent_inspect with an explicit local synthetic .apparent bundle path. The plugin consumes the full Apparent CLI and delivers a multimodal tool result.
prerequisites: Node 22, Python 3 with the plugin's Pillow dependency, taskset, a quiet Linux CPU and SMT sibling, and a private job directory.
A clean full Apparent CLI from the control revision. The pinned Bend compiler is needed only to prepare the two scoring modules.
expectedEvidence: Cold and warm raw milliseconds, monotonic trace, output receipt and resource guards for each sample.
The returned transcript and note match the fixture and the delivered JPEG independently decodes to the expected dimensions and colors.
An immutable control at score 100, timed trace overhead and quiet repeat spread, and a stop decision from the shipped journey policy.
limits: Hermes tool registration, configuration and result delivery use HermesToolHostFixture. No live Hermes session or model inference runs.
The real CLI subprocesses and bundle reads run locally. Connect, native recorder, Desktop rendering and production transport need their own acceptance.
